column1: The game keeps crashing after the latest update and the loading screen freezes every time.
The soundtrack and atmosphere are amazing. I highly recommend this game.
The multiplayer servers are dead and I cannot find any online players.
It is fun, but the campaign is too short and there is not much content.
Not worth the full price. Wait for sale.
The controls are clunky and the combat feels repetitive.
Great music, beautiful art style, and an interesting story.
The frame rate drops constantly and the game is poorly optimized.
